Name: Zhuu's I - Hundred Hues Chests
Author: yhh2324
Description:
Zhuu's I - Hundred Hues Chests
百色宝箱 · Zhuu Studio / 烛的工作室
Give your chests a little more color.
Hundred Hues Chests adds 320 custom chest colors while keeping the original vanilla palette available. Match your storage to your farm, organize items by color, or simply choose a shade you like.
FEATURES
• 320 custom color combinations: 20 hues × 4 saturation levels × 4 lightness levels.
• A compact, two-row palette with a live chest preview.
• Switch between the custom palette and the original vanilla palette.
• Supports Wooden Chest, Stone Chest, Big Chest, and Big Stone Chest.
• Includes English and Simplified Chinese interface text.
HOW TO USE
Open a supported chest and click its color-picker button.
Each click cycles through:
Custom palette → Vanilla palette → Close palette.
In the custom palette, select a hue, saturation, and lightness. Your chest and the preview update as you choose. To return to a vanilla color, switch to the vanilla palette and select a color.
INSTALLATION
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download the main installation file.[/*]
[*]Extract the MoreChestColors folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]The installed folder should contain:
Mods/MoreChestColors/manifest.json
Mods/MoreChestColors/MoreChestColors.dll
Mods/MoreChestColors/i18n/
The separate source-code download is for developers and is not needed to play.
REQUIREMENTS AND TESTING
Requires Stardew Valley and SMAPI. The mod declares SMAPI 4.5.0 as its minimum API version.
Primarily tested on Stardew Valley 1.6.15 with SMAPI 4.5.2. Multiplayer and compatibility with other mods have not been verified.
Version 0.4.4 includes a fix for color-picker click coordinates when changing UI scale, along with palette positioning adjustments.
UNINSTALLING
Close the game and remove the MoreChestColors folder from Mods.
Custom color selections are stored separately in chest mod data. Without this mod, chests display their vanilla colors. The stored custom selections may remain in your save.

百色宝箱
给你的箱子，多一点颜色。
百色宝箱新增了 320 种自定义颜色，同时保留原版调色板。你可以按颜色整理物品、搭配农场风格，或者只是挑一个自己喜欢的颜色。
主要功能
• 20 个色相 × 4 档饱和度 × 4 档明度，共 320 种颜色组合。
• 紧凑的双行调色界面，带实时箱子预览。
• 自定义调色板与原版调色板随时切换。
• 支持木箱、石箱、大木箱和大石箱。
• 提供英文和简体中文界面。
使用方法
打开支持的箱子，点击箱子菜单右侧的调色按钮。
每次点击依次切换：
自定义调色板 → 原版调色板 → 关闭。
在自定义调色板中选择色相、饱和度和明度，箱子颜色与预览会随之更新。若想恢复原版颜色，切换到原版调色板并选择一个颜色即可。
安装方法
[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]下载主文件中的安装包。[/*]
[*]将 MoreChestColors 文件夹解压到游戏的 Mods 文件夹。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]正确路径应为：
Mods/MoreChestColors/manifest.json
独立源码包供开发者查看和构建，普通玩家无需下载。
运行要求与测试情况
需要 Stardew Valley 和 SMAPI。模组声明的最低 SMAPI 版本为 4.5.0。
目前主要在 Stardew Valley 1.6.15 / SMAPI 4.5.2 下测试，尚未验证多人模式及其他模组兼容性。
0.4.4 修复了调整 UI 缩放后调色按钮点击坐标不匹配的问题，并调整了调色面板的定位处理。
卸载方法
关闭游戏后，删除 Mods 中的 MoreChestColors 文件夹。
自定义颜色选项单独保存在箱子的模组数据中。移除模组后，箱子按原版颜色显示；自定义颜色记录可能仍保留在存档内。
